account_evidence: Find evidence supporting or mentioning path nodes.
closure_round: Find targets whose complete method requirements are controlled.
closure_seeds: Resolve the actor's initial controlled nodes.
compile_accounts: Read active accounts and their root roles for compilation.
compile_clear_enables: Remove materialized shortcuts for selected targets.
compile_clear_methods: Remove selected policy methods while preserving observed methods.
compile_enables: Materialize password-free methods with exactly one need.
compile_mailboxes: Match open email roots to their active hosting accounts.
compile_methods: Create compiled methods and their grant targets.
compile_needs: Attach every required prerequisite to a method.
compile_policy_events: Load persisted policy events so recompiles keep post-event methods.
compile_targets: Find targets affected by selected account methods.
demo_phone_values: Set demo phone numbers on the fixture's phone roots.
exec_context: Read the change, account, and old and new roots.
exec_pending: Find released running or assisted changes and their evidence.
exec_release: Release a change's active executor claim.
exec_start: Atomically claim an approved change for execution.
explain: Read scenario derivation branches, using the baseline for lockout.
fixture_accounts: Create fixture accounts and service relationships.
fixture_evidence: Create fixture evidence and its account and root links.
fixture_method_counts: Report compiled method counts per fixture account.
fixture_uses: Create fixture account-to-root roles with evidence metadata.
graph_edge_count: Count all relationships in the selected graph.
graph_node_count: Count all nodes in the selected graph.
ingest_account: Merge a discovered account, service, and supporting evidence.
ingest_account_candidates: Find existing accounts for a service so a changed email keeps the same account.
ingest_closing_email: Apply a closure notice unless a newer notice exists.
ingest_repoint: Remove superseded contact roles unless newer evidence exists.
ingest_role_roots: Read roots associated with a role at the observation time.
ingest_root_device: Create a discovered device root if absent.
ingest_root_email: Create a discovered email root if absent.
ingest_root_phone: Create a discovered phone root if absent.
ingest_signal: Merge an ingestion signal and its root link.
ingest_summary: Count discovery records, confirmed uses, and unknown services.
ingest_use: Merge a root role without overwriting newer contact evidence.
onboarding_declared_use: Confirm a declared dependency for a discovered account matched by service and login email.
onboarding_email: Merge declared email metadata while preserving observed closure notices.
planner_candidates: Group the old root's roles by active account.
planner_change_evidence: Attach completion evidence to a change and its account.
planner_closing_accounts: Find mailbox hosting accounts that close and cannot be migrated.
planner_drop_use: Remove the selected old-root roles in a simulation or completed change.
planner_get_plan: Read a plan with its ordered changes.
planner_list_plans: List plans and their ordered changes, newest first.
planner_repoint_use: Move selected roles to a replacement root, preserving metadata.
planner_save_plan: Persist the plan summary and exposure counts.
planner_save_steps: Persist changes and their plan and account links.
planner_step_order: Connect consecutive changes with BEFORE edges.
planner_update_change: Update a change's status and optional note.
policy_changes: Write contact-change procedures and service links.
policy_clear: Clear the selected policy graph before a full reload.
policy_methods: Write method templates and their service links.
scenario_account: Resolve an account for an explanation.
scenario_accounts: Read accounts and their directly associated roots.
scenario_context: Read roots for scenario seed selection.
scenario_disabled: Find mailbox methods disabled by email loss.
scenario_old: Find scenarios beyond the retention limit.
scenario_prune: Delete expired scenario records and their links.
scenario_prune_derivations: Delete derivations belonging to expired scenarios.
scenario_timing: Persist scenario timing and its serialized result.
signals_detector_adopt: Consolidate equivalent signals while preserving dismissal and delivery state.
signals_detector_devices: Find old authenticator roots implicated by new-device evidence.
signals_detector_expiry: Store a discovered domain expiration on its root.
signals_detector_merge: Upsert a detector signal without reopening dismissed signals.
signals_detector_missed: Find accounts mentioned after a root migration without their own change.
signals_detector_notified: Mark a detector signal's notification delivered.
signals_detector_pending: Find open detector signals awaiting notification.
signals_detector_roots: Read roots and evidence dates for detector checks.
signals_policy_accounts: Select active service accounts not exempt from a policy event.
signals_policy_event: Persist a policy event or its tenant delivery state.
signals_synth_owner: Check a graph's synthetic ownership marker before cleanup.
view_accounts: List accounts or select one account.
view_derived: Read actual reached derivations for the scenario graph view.
view_evidence: Read an account's supporting evidence, newest first.
view_methods: Read methods, grant targets, and all required roots.
view_scenario: Read a scenario and its reached nodes and rounds.
view_search_evidence: Search the Evidence full-text index by relevance.
view_uses: Read account-to-root roles, confidence, and evidence IDs.
wp4_accounts: Read accounts with their service metadata for resolution.
wp4_entity: Resolve a typed graph entity by application ID.
wp4_mailbox_paths: Walk variable-length DERIVED paths to identify mailbox-host reach.
wp4_trace_list: Read tool calls after an optional timestamp.
wp4_trace_write: Persist a tool call's query trace and optional turn link.
wp4_turn_about: Link a conversation turn to mentioned accounts and roots.
wp4_turn_write: Persist a conversation turn and its context.
write_derivation: Persist every prerequisite branch of a scenario derivation.
write_reached: Persist reached nodes with their round and granting method.
write_scenario: Persist a scenario and its initial seed links.
